list.name: target_date
list.label: Target date (night)
list.query:
import "date"
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
pad = (n) => if n < 10 then "0" + string(v: n) else string(v: n)
today = string(v: date.year(t: now())) + "-" + pad(n: date.month(t: now())) + "-" + pad(n: date.monthDay(t: now()))
schema.tagValues(bucket: "campsites", tag: "target_date") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= today)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "availability" and r.target_date == "${target_date}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.agency, set: ${agency:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${campsite:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "available")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "availability" and r.target_date == "${target_date}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.agency, set: ${agency:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${campsite:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "reserved")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "availability" and r.target_date == "${target_date}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.agency, set: ${agency:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${campsite:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "availability" and r.target_date == "${target_date}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.agency, set: ${agency:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${campsite:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "reserved" or r._field == "total")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["name"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> reduce(fn: (r, acc) => ({ reserved: acc.reserved + r.reserved, total: acc.total + r.total }), identity: { reserved: 0, total: 0 })
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: if r.total > 0 then float(v: r.reserved) / float(v: r.total) * 100.0 else 0.0 }))

panels.title: Available vs Booked over time (sum across selection)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "availability" and r.target_date == "${target_date}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.agency, set: ${agency:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${campsite:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "available" or r._field == "reserved")
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Booked sites by agency over time (stacked)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "availability" and r.target_date == "${target_date}" and r._field == "reserved")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.agency, set: ${agency:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["agency", "_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["agency"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "campsites")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "availability" and r.target_date == "${target_date}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.agency, set: ${agency:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.name, set: ${campsite:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "available" or r._field == "reserved" or r._field == "total")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["name", "agency"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with booked_pct: if r.total > 0 then float(v: r.reserved) / float(v: r.total) * 100.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "agency", "available", "reserved", "total", "booked_pct"])
  |> sort(columns: ["booked_pct"], desc: true)
